echosegnet.reason: The released pipeline needs registered RGB/COLMAP frames, 2D object proposals and per-scene Gaussian splatting; none are observations in this LiDAR/audio package. No full trained checkpoint is present.

jaeger.reason: The published model requires RGB-D and calibrated first-order ambisonics; the dataset has point LiDAR and four point microphones. No local JAEGER/Qwen checkpoint is present.

said.reason: The published weights expect Eigenmike capsules [6,10,26,22] at 48 kHz with rigid-sphere responses; the dataset has a free-field tetrahedral point array at 44.1 kHz. The checkpoint is not present locally.

magnet.reason: MAGNet needs RGB/depth, navigation actions and simulator trajectories. The specified dataset has source-conditioned receiver menus, so a source-independent active comparison is invalid. No compatible trained policy is present locally.

sound3dvdet.reason: The released model fuses multiview RGB features with microphone features; the dataset has no RGB observations. The repo references an epoch-100 checkpoint but includes no model weights, and its LoFTR path is external.
